players.product: DRAM / HBM and NAND probe cards, test interface boards and test sockets

quarterly_data.signal: Deck roadmap by business: probe cards - HBM4E development and securing qualification, new Flash products and wider mass production, fine-pitch interposer development; interface boards - the company claims global top-3-level competitiveness and expects demand to keep rising with AI server and data-center investment, plus a growing LC component market; test sockets - strategy to win share in high-spec flagship products, expects SoC socket demand to grow, and targets share in the AI-chip socket market by 2030
Deck: Q1 2026 results; memory accounted for 75% and non-memory for 25% of separate (parent) sales in Q1 2026
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 150,671M, operating profit KRW 41,992M; separate revenue KRW 117,850M, operating profit KRW 36,994M; memory 75% / non-memory 25%
